chunks: Moneyview is a digital lending platform. Its app had 134.14 million registered users by March 2026.
Most personal loans are funded by 48 financial partners, with its own NBFC, Whizdm Finance, also lending.
The managed book of unsecured personal loans was ₹21,380.14 Cr, and annualised losses on those loans eased to 6.95% in FY26.
